usercssData.name: Github Optimized Layout
usercssData.description: Optimized layout for github.com and gist.github.com, with a max width of 85vw and full-width diffs/commits. Also includes some minor component fixes for PR lists and merge boxes. Based on the "Github Full Width" style by user 1j01, but with a more targeted approach to avoid breaking pages that rely on the default 100% width (like Actions and Security). The style uses a combination of root-level variables for easy customization and specific selectors to ensure it only affects the intended layout containers. The goal is to provide a more comfortable reading experience without sacrificing functionality or breaking any pages.
